items.author: Trump
items.text: Gasoline Retailers must get their Prices down, IMMEDIATELY! They’re too high considering that Oil is now at $68 a Barrel, and heading south. The Retailers must quickly react to this statement, and do what they know is right — DROP YOUR PRICE FOR OUR GREAT AMERICAN PEOPLE! There will be no gauging, which is totally illegal. If Retailers don’t do this, big problems lie ahead! Start targeting around the $2.50 a Gallon number, and California should stop charging such heavy Taxes on their Gasoline. Soon the Tax will be higher than the Product itself, and the United States will not stand for it, nor
items.summary_cn: Trump 公开施压汽油零售商降价，点名批评加州高汽油税，并警告 $68 油价下零售价应降至 $2.50/加仑——对炼油与加油站板块偏空，对油价/能源股有间接影响。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Wedbush Initiates SpaceX Coverage With 'Outperform' Rating, $190 Price Target
items.summary_cn: Wedbush 首次覆盖 SpaceX 给出 Outperform 与 $190 目标价——SpaceX 未上市不可直接交易，但 kcn 持有 SPCH(2x 做多 SpaceX ETF)间接受益。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Elon Musk Says He Would Be 'Disappointed' If SpaceX Does Not ‘Significantly Exceed’ These Bullish Revenue Milestones
items.summary_cn: Musk 称若 SpaceX 不'大幅超越'既定收入里程碑他会'失望'——管理层放卫星姿态偏乐观，间接利好 kcn 持有的 SPCH。

items.author: Musk
items.text: Musk Is A Trillionaire Again: SpaceX And Tesla Boost Net Worth By $60 Billion
items.summary_cn: Musk 净资产再破万亿美元，SpaceX 与 Tesla 估值贡献 $600 亿——为 SPCH(2x SpaceX) 提供正面前景，但对 kcn 持仓为间接利好。
